messages:
Alex: Quick async check on OKR milestones — short status please (shipped / slipped / next step). Owners I know about: @Maria (auth), @Jeremy (embeddings), @Lina (routing). Drop one-line updates + any asks.
Maria: Auth token rotation v2 — shipped to prod yesterday, canary ramped 1%->100%. PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1246. Next: monitor latency and error budget for 24h. :tada:
Jeremy: Embeddings pipeline refactor — deployed to staging; perf and cost improvements look good from initial runs. Need one more sign-off from @Sam on accuracy tests before prod push. ETA EOD Fri.
Sam: I'll run the accuracy suite today. Quick note: micro-batching change revealed a reranker regression, opened issue #392. Will triage with @Maria.
Maria: Thanks — repro steps are in the issue. Failing unit snippet for reviewers: ```python
assert rerank(scores) > 0.7
```
Alex: Nice. Now the routing work — multi-tenant smart routing (owner @Lina) — where are we?
Lina: Routing slipped. Perf harness shows ~15% tail latency increase when seq > 1024 under current selection policy. Looks like cache eviction + kernel selection mismatch. PR in flight: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/770.
Alex: What do you need from eng-infra/platform to move that?
Lina: We need kernel tuning and a short canary with a fallback policy. @eng-infra / @Devops-oncall — can you allocate one extra GPU pool for a 2-hour canary tomorrow morning (UTC) and help run the perf harness?
Devops-oncall: I can allocate burst capacity tomorrow 09:00-11:00 UTC. Please paste the canary manifest and perf script. :white_check_mark:
Lina: Will do — posting manifest in the PR shortly. Also flagging dependency on config rollout from @product-config-team; if that slips we fallback to old routing policy.
Jeremy: Small ask — need 1-2 reviewers on PR 1246 for auth rollback safety docs. @Maria already updated docs but missing edge-case note on KMS rotation. @Sam can you take a look?
Sam: I can review this afternoon. If it's blocking release, ping me in DMs.
Alex: Action list summary: 1) Monitor auth v2 24h (owner Maria). 2) Embeddings -> prod after @Sam sign-off (owner Jeremy). 3) Reranker regression triage (Sam + Maria). 4) Routing canary + kernel tuning (Lina + eng-infra) — canary scheduled tomorrow 09:00-11:00 UTC. 5) PR reviewers for auth rollback doc (Jeremy -> Sam). If anything blocks, mark it on the OKR board and tag me. :spiral_calendar:
Product-bot: OKR board cards updated automatically: https://okrs.redwood.ai/board/quarter-3
Alex: Thanks all — if you can help with reviews or perf runs, drop availability here. I'll ping leads in ~24h for an update. :calendar:
